integrity: Proof is analytic; two different executable finite regressions are provided verbatim and run; finite checks are explicitly bounded.
scientific_limitations: Only simple Cartesian cycle products of orders at least three; does not enumerate nonminimum weights. Finite regression checks are not an unbounded proof. Full historical priority and independent scholarly validation remain unestablished.
title: A sharp quarter–half density phase diagram for parity domination on Cartesian tori
